cards.card_text: His servants ask, "What is this you have done?" He fasted and wept while the child was alive, but now that the child has died, he gets up and eats.
cards.verse_text: “While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but when he died, you got up and ate.”
cards.snippet: “While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but when he died, you got up and ate.”

cards.card_text: David says he wept and fasted.
cards.verse_text: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
cards.snippet: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.

cards.card_text: But they've got a question for God: “Why have we fasted, and You have not seen?” That's like posting a picture of your best batch and getting ZERO likes.
cards.verse_text: “Why have we fasted, and You have not seen?
cards.snippet: “Why have we fasted, and You have not seen?

cards.card_text: The people have fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for seventy years.
cards.verse_text: “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?
